purpose: Yonne farm-structure (CDOA) decisions whose land includes Chablis but which print no parcel reference. Producer-research leads only.
method: Initial full-text triage, with page-image correction on 7 October 2026. Review status is recorded per decision; the Chablis Tier 1 audit records every reviewed page.
limitation: Commune-level only: never parcel evidence, never assignable to a current parcel, and an authorisation does not establish actual or current farming. Yonne CDOA decisions print areas and communes, not parcel references.
